metadata.title: EOS MCP Tool Redundancy & Duplicate Capability Register
metadata.impact: High cognitive overload, dual truth sources, confusing agent routing

clusters.analysis: eos.evidence.record writes physical JSON receipts to .missions/<id>/evidence/, whereas eos.kernel.evidence generates in-memory receipts from EOSKernel without disk binding.
clusters.recommendation: Unify into eos.evidence.record backed by EOSKernel.

clusters.analysis: eos.mission.start creates file-based packages via McpMissionBridge/MissionRuntime; eos.orchestrator.init initializes state machines in EOSOrchestrator and registers ontology nodes.
clusters.recommendation: Merge into a single mission lifecycle init pipeline.

clusters.analysis: eos.mission.resolve returns a static proposed pipeline string; eos.intent.expand performs formal EARS/BDD AST expansion.
eos.scaffolder.generate generates raw template arrays; eos.scaffolder.clean generates physical spec/test/domain triads on disk and indexes them into knowledge ontology.
clusters.recommendation: Deprecate eos.scaffolder.generate in favor of clean triad generation.

clusters.analysis: Three separate tools inspect the same mission package to output raw JSON, formatted report markdown, or ANSI terminal UI.
clusters.recommendation: Parameterize format on eos.mission.status (json, markdown, ansi).

clusters.analysis: eos.fdir.status checks killswitch & drift; eos.sentinel.self_remember checks process heap memory.
clusters.recommendation: Include heap metrics in fdir status report.

clusters.analysis: Both tools have identical descriptions in CANONICAL_TOOLS ("Triadic force fusion token certification, inter-enclave secure channel attestation, and post-quantum state sealing") and return mock sha256 tokens.
clusters.recommendation: Remove both from canonical MCP catalog.

clusters.analysis: Multiple tools wrap ledger transaction calls with slightly different payload envelopes.
clusters.recommendation: Use single canonical ledger write tool with typed transaction category.
